text:
marissa: Heads-up — in the sprint prep I found an inline anchor on the serving-runtime page that 404s when you click it (the 'KV cache' anchor). Can someone who owns that doc take a quick look? :eyes:

samir: which URL exactly? I can try a quick grep in the repo if you paste it.

marissa: https://internal.redwood/docs/serving-runtime#kv-cache — when I jump to the section the browser stays at top of page. Might be a frontmatter/change in heading text.

doc-bot: automated-scan: detected 1 dead-anchor on /docs/serving-runtime (last scanned 2026-03-02). Recommended owner: eng-runtime. See /docs/scan-results/2255 for details.

anya: I maintain that doc but haven't touched anchors recently. I'll open a quick PR. If it's a heading rename it'll be a one-line fix.

oliver: thanks @anya. If it's a content move, can you also check whether any templates reference the old anchor? We have a few try-it snippets that deep-link to anchors.

anya: will do. Quick local check I run: 
```bash
# find candidate files linking to the anchor
grep -R "serving-runtime#kv-cache" docs/ || true
```
If nothing shows up, it's probably an H2->H3 rename.

matt: FYI the CLI docs generator sometimes normalizes headings differently after the last mdx upgrade, so anchors can shift. If you need, I can run the heading->slug script and diff.

samir: if @anya wants a hand, ping me and I can run a mass-scan to list all internal links pointing at that anchor across the site.

anya: thanks, I'll start with a small PR: rename the heading slug back to old form and add a redirect frontmatter if needed. Will drop the PR link here when ready.

marissa: awesome — not blocking the sprint but want the runbook links in the deck to be stable before the review. :thumbsup:

doc-bot: reminder: when you open the PR, include the failing anchor id in the PR description and add the label `docs/anchor-fix` — automated backfill will pick it up.

anya: PR up: https://internal.redwood/pulls/9876 — small heading tweak + redirect frontmatter. @matt can you run the heading diff check before merge?

matt: on it, will run and report back in 20m.

samir: if all good, maybe also add a tiny unit test to the link-scan CI so we catch this earlier. Not a blocker for this PR but a follow-up GH issue would be great.

anya: noted — creating issue after merge. Thanks y'all. :sparkles:
